business_summary: Zhejiang Yingfeng Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textiles printing and dyeing processing business in China. The company offers knitted and woven fabrics, including roman cloth, nylon, polyester, cotton, polyester cotton, human cotton, modal, bengaline, jinmian, all cotton, jindi, and rensi hemp series, as well as grey cloth. Its products are used in casual wear, sportswear, and business formal wear applications. The company also engages in trading; research and development; advanced printing and dyeing technologies; technology development; and investing activities. Zhejiang Yingfeng Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.

Its products are used in casual wear, sportswear, and business formal wear applications. The company also engages in trading; 연구 및 개발; 고급 인쇄 및 염색 기술; 기술개발; 및 투자 활동. Zhejiang Yingfeng Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.
